{'translation': 'Today Apple is celebrating the opening of its advanced manufacturing center in Houston, Texas. Details below.', 'translation_zh': '今日 Apple 慶祝其位於德州侯斯頓嘅先進製造中心開幕。以下係詳情。'}

{'translation': 'Apple to train business leaders at new advanced manufacturing center in Houston', 'translation_zh': 'Apple 將於侯斯頓新成立嘅先進製造中心培訓商業領袖'}

{'translation': 'Apple today opened its brand-new Advanced Manufacturing Center (AMC) in Houston. The center offers free training and educational courses for small and medium-sized businesses, giving them direct access to the most advanced equipment, interactive labs, and tools they need to accelerate innovation. The AMC is located within the same Houston facility that produces and ships Apple\'s advanced AI servers and will begin producing Mac mini later this year. […] Apple CEO Tim Cook said: "In less than nine months, we have invested hundreds of millions of dollars in this Houston facility. We have built the factory, started production, and shipped the first batch of advanced AI servers off the production line. Today, we are delighted to open the new Advanced Manufacturing Center, a place where businesses, workers, and students can learn the same innovative processes we use to make Apple\'s most groundbreaking products. We also look forward to starting Mac mini production later this year." He also said: "We believe in American workers and American creativity, and we are moving forward at an incredible pace, because what we want to create is more than just good products. We want to build the future of American manufacturing."', 'translation_zh': 'Apple 今日喺侯斯頓開設咗全新嘅先進製造中心（Advanced Manufacturing Center，AMC）。該中心為中小型企業提供免費培訓及教育課程，等佢哋可以直接接觸最先進嘅設備、互動實驗室同所需工具，以加速創新。AMC 設於同一個侯斯頓廠房入面，該廠房負責生產及付運 Apple 嘅先進 AI 伺服器，並將於今年開始生產 Mac mini。[……] Apple 行政總裁 Tim Cook 表示：「喺不足九個月內，我哋已經投資咗數億美元喺呢個侯斯頓廠房。我哋建立咗工廠、開始投產，並將首批先進 AI 伺服器從生產線付運出去。今日，我哋好高興可以開設全新嘅先進製造中心，呢個地方可以畀企業、工人同學生學習我哋用嚟製造 Apple 最突破性產品嘅同樣創新流程。我哋亦好期待喺今年稍後開始 Mac mini 嘅生產工作。」佢又話：「我哋相信美國工人同美國嘅創造力，我哋正以驚人嘅速度推進，因為我哋想創造嘅唔止係好產品。我哋想建立美國製造業嘅未來。」'}

{'translation': 'Tim Cook said via social media that he had arrived in Houston to attend the opening event. Also attending the launch ceremony were government officials, including U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick, U.S. Senator Ted Cruz, Houston Mayor John Whitmire, U.S. Representative Christian Menefee, Harris County Precinct One Commissioner Rodney Ellis, and others.', 'translation_zh': 'Tim Cook 透過社交媒體表示佢已經抵達侯斯頓出席開幕活動。出席啟動儀式嘅仲有政府官員，包括美國商務部長 Howard Lutnick、美國參議員 Ted Cruz、侯斯頓市長 John Whitmire、美國眾議員 Christian Menefee、哈里斯縣第一選區專員 Rodney Ellis 等。'}

{'translation': 'The AMC occupies 20,000 square feet, where Apple experts will "share their knowledge directly with participating businesses and entrepreneurs, helping to accelerate the development of smart manufacturing across the United States."', 'translation_zh': 'AMC 佔地兩萬平方呎，Apple 專家將喺度「直接向參與嘅企業同創業者分享佢哋嘅知識，協助加快全美嘅智能製造業發展」。'}

{'translation': 'The first cohort of business leaders arrived today to take part in the inaugural training session. The day\'s topics focused on smart manufacturing technologies, including "machine learning-driven quality control and advanced automation."', 'translation_zh': '首批商業領袖今日已經到場參加史上首次嘅培訓課程。當日嘅課題集中喺智能製造技術，包括「由機器學習驅動嘅品質控制同先進自動化」。'}
